origine_fr: La moitié gauche de 行, un carrefour : 彳 marque la route depuis plus de 3 000 ans. Il veut dire « petits pas ». On l'appelle 双人旁, « deux hommes », et il marque la marche, comme dans 往, aller vers.
origine_en: It is the left half of 行, a crossroads: 彳 stands for the road, and it was already written this way 3,000 years ago. It means “small steps”. It is called 双人旁, “double person”, and it appears in characters about walking, like 往, to go towards.
